build.beforeBuildCommand: npm run build && cd src-tauri/zalo-sidecar && npm install && npx esbuild index.mjs --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --banner:js="Object.defineProperty(globalThis,'__importMetaUrl',{get:()=>'file://'+__filename});" --define:import.meta.url=globalThis.__importMetaUrl --outfile=bundle.cjs

security.csp: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data: blob: https:; connect-src 'self' ipc: http://ipc.localhost
